scope: User-approved Koharu engine migration; PaddleOCR and installed local development tools excluded

contracts.lamaAot: LibTorch explicit model paths and app-installed native runtime
contracts.flux: stable-diffusion.cpp, explicit transformer / Qwen3 text encoder / full-encoder small-decoder VAE
contracts.animeText: Existing YOLO12 and postprocessing, Candle 0.11 F32, portable sm75 CUDA kernels; existing ZLUDA path retained
contracts.orchestration: Old crop, balloon, mask, alpha and pixel-budget behavior characterized before moving into runner-image-processing
contracts.windowsPaths: UTF-8 activeCodePage manifests; no system locale change
contracts.amd: Native ROCm 10 exact-device probe and managed packages; hardware validation pending
contracts.mac: Native Metal libraries and colocated worker; hardware validation pending

validation.smokeFixture: Synthetic 256x256 manga lettering mask; validates execution, dimensions and JSON protocol, not image-quality equivalence between engines
validation.windowsUnicodeRegression: All production smokes used Korean absolute paths; SDCPP failed before the process UTF-8 manifest fix
validation.coldRemoteInstall: Empty native-cold-r1 data root: actual app installers fetched LaMa CPU libraries and FLUX CPU runner/runtime from remote, and both workers completed inference.
validation.rocmInstall: Actual ROCm 10 core/libraries/gfx1100 archive installation passed under a long Korean Windows data path. Core DLL probe loaded successfully and returned HIP status 100/devices 0 on the NVIDIA-only machine; AMD inference is unverified.
validation.hfAssets: npm run verify:hf-assets: 36 assets verified, including pinned new VAE and Qwen3 text encoder.

ui.result: Actual FluxBackendSettings component, supported/unsupported AMD states, 1440x900 and 390x844; no horizontal overflow, clipping or overlap. Temporary entrypoints removed.

introducedCoverage.result: 21 tests passed; three new native modules measured separately. Existing coverage floors unchanged.

validation.windowsCpuPortability: PE import-table regression guard rejects nvcuda/cudart/cublas/curand loader imports. Actual LaMa and AnimeText CPU inference passed with PATH restricted to Windows/System32 and app-private MSVC DLLs.
validation.coverageRetirement: Existing numerical coverage floors were not lowered. Removed the baseline entry for deleted, unreachable zludaRuntime.ts and the introduced entry for deleted hipSdk.ts; scope manifest tracks 817 existing, 1336 added and 12 deleted files.

build.cudaCompiler: Existing CUDA 12.9, only needed for AnimeText Candle kernels
build.nativeCudaRuntime: Official CUDA 13.3 packages, downloaded independently of local CUDA
build.msvcRuntime: Official signed Microsoft VC++ 14.51.36247.0 DLLs, extracted without running the installer
removedLegacy: Flux Candle Metal wrapper and its implementation-specific QMatMul test
Unreferenced Flux manual HIP SDK discovery and ZLUDA support installer; separate AnimeText ZLUDA retained

candleCorePatch.contract: Switch cudarc from dynamic-linking to dynamic-loading. Link static CUDART on Windows for native kernel registration before main; optional NVIDIA DLLs are loaded only when AnimeText selects CUDA.

release.contract: Four flat ZIP archives plus binding manifest.json; five server assets matched names, bytes and SHA-256 after re-download. Archive member inventories verified. Immutable asset-only prerelease; no application release.

remaining: Final isolated remote model installation/inference receipt

consumerContracts.runtimeCache: koharu-0.83.5-r1 + platform/backend/engine/exact ROCm target; package fingerprint and file SHA receipts
consumerContracts.models: Transformer unchanged; FLUX.2-small-decoder full_encoder_small_decoder.safetensors and Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf pinned by revision/SHA
consumerContracts.backendMigration: Existing zluda-native/python-rocm choices normalize to rocm-native for inpainting. AnimeText retains its separate Candle/ZLUDA contract. Legacy supportsFluxZluda IPC field now describes native ROCm package availability, not AMD hardware certification.
consumerContracts.gpuSelection: ROCm probes an unmasked physical adapter index before selecting the exact gfx package, then uses the same adapter for worker visibility. CUDA keeps UUID binding.
consumerContracts.nativeDllSearch: Managed CUDA 13.3/ROCm/MSVC directories precede host PATH; native workers skip legacy CUDA 12.9 discovery.

rollback: Revert migration commits as one source/catalog/native-binary unit to dependency checkpoint 39e997ff. Old external releases and caches are retained; new assets use unique tags/cache versions. Never delete library, originals or outputs.
